name: Kühtaier Schlössl
beschreibung: Kühtaier Schlössl welcomes winter sports enthusiasts and alpine adventurers to snow-sure Kühtai in the municipality of Silz, perched at an altitude of over 2,020 meters. As Austria’s highest winter resort, Kühtai guarantees exceptional snow conditions from November late into spring. The property features comfortable alpine-style rooms and spacious self-catering apartments. A soothing wellness area with a sauna and steam room offers total relaxation after high-altitude exploits. Benefiting from a prime slopeside setting, guests enjoy true ski-in/ski-out convenience, while summer reveals pristine high-alpine hiking and mountaineering terrain.
kurzbeschreibung: Alpine lodge and holiday apartments in Austria's highest winter sports village in Kühtai at 2,020 meters.
